    FAQs

    What is Sleepyhead?

    Sleepyhead is a leading brand in the world of sleep and home comfort. We offer a range of premium mattresses, sofas, recliners, beds, and other home furnishing items designed to enhance your well-being and provide you with the utmost comfort and style. 

    Is Sleepyhead mattress price worth it?

    Absolutely! Our Sleepyhead mattresses are thoughtfully designed with quality materials to ensure a comfortable and rejuvenating sleep experience. We believe that investing in a good mattress is an investment in your health and well-being.

    How are Sleepyhead mattresses?

    Our Sleepyhead mattresses are expertly crafted using innovative technology and premium materials to provide exceptional comfort and support. They are designed to promote better sleep and overall well-being.

    Is Sleepyhead an Indian brand?

    Yes, Sleepyhead is proudly an Indian brand committed to offering high-quality sleep and home comfort solutions to our customers.

    What is the number 1 best mattress in India?

    While opinions on the best mattress may vary, Sleepyhead has gained recognition as a top choice for many customers seeking quality, comfort, and value in India. Sleepyhead is the number 1 best mattress in India.

    Is Sleepyhead mattress safe to use?

    Yes, Sleepyhead mattresses are safe to use. We prioritize the use of high-quality, non-toxic materials to ensure your health and well-being.

    Why is Sleepyhead so good?

    Sleepyhead is known for its commitment to quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Our products are designed to provide you with the best possible sleep and home comfort experience.

    Which is the best Sleepyhead mattress?

    We offer a range of Sleepyhead mattresses to cater to different preferences and needs. The best mattress for you depends on your individual comfort and support requirements.

    What are Sleepyhead mattresses made of?

    Our Sleepyhead mattresses are made with a combination of premium materials, including memory foam, pocket springs, and high-density foam, to deliver the perfect blend of comfort and support.

    Which mattress brand is better?

    Sleepyhead is known for its high-quality mattresses and excellent customer reviews. We encourage you to explore our range and choose the one that suits you best. So, the Sleepyhead mattress brand is better.

    Buy Sleepyhead mattresses

    After disrupting the mattress market with our innovative Bed-In-A-Box concept we are once again here to change the way people sleep and experience comfort. Our exclusive technology BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam with its inbuilt intelligence redefines your sleep experience.

    Did you know that those who have insomnia, back pain, or spinal misalignment call us the best brand? Here’s why they do so. We took memory foam and dialled it up a notch to match your ever-changing lifestyle needs. Our exclusive Sleepyhead BodyIQ Technology with its enhanced adaptation properties provides you with personalized support and comfort. Sleepyhead’s exclusive BodyIQ Technology uses a specialized formulation that enhances the responsiveness

    of the memory foam at a molecular level making it smartly contour itself to everybody, no matter what shape, weight or position you are in. Our BodyIQ Technology is available in our bestselling mattresses – Original and Sense. In Sense Mattress, our BodyIQ Orthopedic Memory Foam is supercharged with cooling technology to further enhance your sleep comfort.

    We have a 3-layer orthopedic mattress specially designed for posture retention. Each material is layered to create a breathable sleep surface, go easy on your spine and joints, and cradle you in soft-but-not-too-soft cushioned comfort. Basically, no aches and pains when you crawl out of bed in the morning...or the afternoon if that’s your vibe.

    Are you looking for a natural, organic haven? Sleepyhead Laxe is the best for you. And if you’re a hot sleeper, our mattresses are infused with a cooling gel that will cool you down just right. If you want the best of both worlds, we recommend the Sleepyhead Flip. It has the dual benefit of high-density foam on one surface of the mattress and a comfort layer on the other, making it supportive and soft.

    When it comes to choosing a mattress, there's no one-size-fits-all solution. Your ideal mattress should cater to your specific needs and preferences.
